in_sanskrit.name: Đj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breath, Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Đj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Đj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhyana', which means 'meditation' or 'absorption'. In Hinduism, the god Vayu is the deity of breath and wind, and the name Đj can be seen as a representation of the life force that sustains us all.
